newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 16.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Oct 16:
WASHINGTON - A U.S. court in St Louis blocked federal rules that aim to open the $100 billion local telephone market to competition.

WASHINGTON - Justice Department officials said their investigation into international cartels in the food additives industry is not over and the government will have the full cooperation of ADM as it continues the probe.
GENEVA - Nearly two years after the World Trade Organisation began operations, it is becoming clear that the United States has benefited greatly.
WASHINGTON - The Securities and Exchange Commission halted trading in the stock of Novatek International Inc., a Columbia, Maryland firm that had started selling medical supplies to South America.
WASHINGTON - Kiwi International Airlines announced it would cease operations after running out of cash.
